canonical_name: Oleinik entropy condition for a scalar conservation law
canonical_statement: Provisional source identity only: for a one-dimensional scalar conservation law u_t + f(u)_x = 0, the Oleinik admissibility condition constrains shocks by a one-sided secant-slope inequality between the left and right traces. The repository metadata does not specify the inequality orientation, flux hypotheses, solution class, or whether the intended claim is the condition itself or an existence/uniqueness theorem, so no exact proposition is frozen at intake.
